title: Approaching The End Of An Era
section_path: Approaching The End Of An Era
section_path_text: Approaching The End Of An Era
summary:
Lower North Sea output accelerates fall in ton-mile demand
Yesterday, Equinor and Shell, two major European oil companies with a rich history of exploration and production in the North Sea decided to combine their UK offshore oil and gas assets in a 50/50 Joint Venture (JV). The JV is not growth oriented. To the contrary, the JV will harvest value as the assets naturally decline.
